title: Contract verbs
subtitle: Recognize vowels contracting in common verbs.
overview: When a stem ending in α, ε, or ο meets a vowel ending, the vowels contract. Learn the visible present forms rather than trying to hear every underlying vowel.
ἀγαπάω and ποιέω are especially common in the New Testament.

sections.title: Two common contractions
rows: you love → he or she loves
you do → he or she does

items.en: He or she does the will of God.
